features: Knowles-Powered Dual Drivers with boAt HiFi Sound: Dive into the audio realm with the thumping boAt HiFi Sound from the 10 mm drivers of the boAt Nirvana X TWS Earbuds. Additionally, the two Knowles-enabled drivers reciprocate the frequency response of the preferred listening curve in your earbuds for a highly enjoyable audio experience
Hi-Res Audio by LDAC: Level up your listening with LDAC codec that can compress audio files without compromising the audio quality

4 Mics with AI-ENx Technology: Enjoy noise cancellation powered by Artificial Intelligence in the four mics for crystal-clear communication indoors and outdoors. Plug in your Nirvana X TWS and get going with your calls without hassles
boAt Adaptive EQ by Mimi: Get personalized listening with Adaptive EQ by Mimi technologies. Set up your profile and listen to movies, series, and podcasts without cranking hearing profile
In-Ear Detection: Maximize wireless comfort with the in-ear detection function. Remove your earbuds to pause the content and simply wear them again to resume playback
